Now I have a complete picture. Let me compile the findings.

Here is a comprehensive analysis of all `descriptorId` usages across the codebase.

---

## 1. What `descriptorId` Is

`descriptorId` is an optional string field on `BreadcrumbStackItem` (defined in `navigation-meta.ts:156`) that tags each breadcrumb node with a semantic type identifier. It links a runtime breadcrumb item back to a static `BreadcrumbItemDescriptor` in the navigation DAG, enabling icon lookup and breadcrumb dropdown rule matching.

```
/apps/desktop/src/navigation/navigation-meta.ts:152-171
  BreadcrumbStackItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon?: IconData;
    descriptorId?: string;   // <-- the field in question
    ...
    meta?: { workspaceId?, section?, pageSlug?, agentId?, executorType?, ... }
  }
```

---

## 2. How `descriptorId` Is Set When Creating BreadcrumbStackItems

There are three factory functions that accept and pass through `descriptorId`:

**`createBreadcrumbItem` — `/apps/desktop/src/navigation/breadcrumb-stack.ts:49-62`**
```typescript
export function createBreadcrumbItem(
  item: Omit<BreadcrumbStackItem, "target"> & {
    descriptorId?: string;
    location?: DesktopLocation;
  }
): BreadcrumbStackItem {
  return {
    ...item,
    icon: item.icon ?? getDescriptorIcon(item.descriptorId),  // fallback icon from descriptor
    ...
  };
}
```

**`createLocationBreadcrumbItem` — `/apps/desktop/src/navigation/breadcrumb-stack.ts:64-80`**
```typescript
export function createLocationBreadcrumbItem(
  location: DesktopLocation,
  item: Partial<...> & { descriptorId?: string }
): BreadcrumbStackItem {
  return createBreadcrumbItem({
    ...
    descriptorId: item?.descriptorId,
    location,
  });
}
```

**`createBreadcrumbNode` — `/apps/desktop/src/navigation/navigation-state.ts:27-46`**
Used for building stacks from descriptor arrays, passes `descriptor.descriptorId` through.

### Where each call site sets a specific value:

**`/apps/desktop/src/navigation/location-navigation.ts` — `createStackForLocation`:**
| Location kind | descriptorId assigned |
|---|---|
| root (workspace) | `"workspace"` (line 147) |
| `workspace-section` | `` `workspace-section:${location.section}` `` (line 168) |
| `workspace-agent-detail` (section parent) | `"workspace-section:agent"` (line 189) |
| `workspace-agent-detail` (leaf) | `"workspace-agent"` (line 201) |
| `workspace-executor-detail` (section parent) | `"workspace-section:agent"` (line 216) |
| `workspace-executor-detail` (leaf) | `"workspace-executor"` (line 228) |
| `workspace-web` | `"workspace-web"` (line 261) |
| `agent-detail` (parent) | `"virtual-folder"` (line 277) |
| `agent-detail` (leaf) | `"workspace-agent"` (line 284) |
| `executor-detail` (parent) | `"virtual-folder"` (line 297) |
| `executor-detail` (leaf) | `"workspace-executor"` (line 304) |
| `skill-detail` / `mcp-server-detail` / `subagent-detail` / `prompt-detail` / `command-detail` (leaf) | `"workspace-executor"` / `"workspace-page"` (lines 317, 328, 341, 352, 365, 376, 389, 400, 413, 424) |
| `settings` (root) | `"settings"` (line 437) |
| `settings` (section) | `` `settings:${location.section}` `` (line 446) |

---

## 3. How `descriptorId` Is Consumed/Read

### A. Icon Resolution (the primary automatic use)

**`/apps/desktop/src/navigation/navigation-meta.ts:308-311`**
```typescript
export function getDescriptorIcon(descriptorId: string | undefined): IconData | undefined {
  if (!descriptorId) return undefined;
  return DESCRIPTOR_BY_ID.get(descriptorId)?.icon;
}
```
This is called immediately inside `createBreadcrumbItem` as a fallback when no explicit `icon` is provided. The lookup map `DESCRIPTOR_BY_ID` covers `GLOBAL_ROUTE_DESCRIPTORS`, `WORKSPACE_SECTION_DESCRIPTORS`, and `SETTINGS_SECTION_DESCRIPTORS` by their `id`.

**`/apps/desktop/src/components/global-tab-bar/sortable-tab-item.tsx:38-43`**
```typescript
function getTabIconData(tab: TabViewModel): IconData {
  if (tab.icon) {
    return tab.icon;
  }
  return getDescriptorIcon(tab.descriptorId) ?? { type: "lucide", value: "file-text" };
}
```
The tab bar calls `getDescriptorIcon(tab.descriptorId)` as a fallback icon for the tab label, where `tab.descriptorId` is derived from the leaf `BreadcrumbStackItem` of the tab's current navigation state (`tab-store.ts:262`).

### B. TabViewModel — Propagation to Tab Store

**`/apps/desktop/src/stores/tab-store.ts:251-265`**
```typescript
export function getTabViewModel(tab: PageTab): TabViewModel {
  const leaf = getTabCurrentLeaf(tab);
  return {
    ...tab,
    ...
    descriptorId: leaf?.descriptorId,  // pulled from top of breadcrumb stack
    ...
  };
}
```
The `descriptorId` of the topmost breadcrumb item flows into the `TabViewModel` and is used by the tab bar for icon display.

### C. Breadcrumb Dropdown Rule Matching

**`/apps/desktop/src/navigation/page-index.ts:612,751`** — `resolvePageIndexBranch`
```typescript
const descriptorId = resolveSegmentDescriptorId(segment);
...
const matchedRule = rules.find((rule) => rule.matches(input, descriptorId));
```
The rules check `descriptorId` to decide which dropdown items to show when a user clicks a breadcrumb segment:

| Rule condition | What dropdown is shown |
|---|---|
| `descriptorId === "workspace"` (line 632) | Workspace switcher list |
| `descriptorId === "virtual-folder"` or `"settings"` + `/settings/` href (line 646-647) | Workspace switcher list |
| `descriptorId === "virtual-folder"` or `"workspace-section:apps"` + apps href (line 663-664) | Workspace section switcher |
| `descriptorId?.startsWith("settings")` (line 681) | Settings section list |
| `descriptorId?.startsWith("workspace-section:")` (line 694) | Workspace section switcher |
| `descriptorId === "workspace-page"` (line 709) | Sibling pages at same depth |

**`resolveSegmentDescriptorId` — `/apps/desktop/src/navigation/page-index.ts:252-283`**
This function infers a `descriptorId` from the segment's href when no explicit one is set, providing a fallback for segments that didn't get one assigned.

### D. Navigation Shell Header — Workspace Detection

**`/apps/desktop/src/components/navigation/navigation-shell.tsx:93`**
```typescript
if (root.descriptorId === "workspace" && root.meta?.workspaceId) {
  const workspace = workspaces.find(item => item.id === root.meta?.workspaceId);
  if (workspace) {
    return { workspace, segments: rest.map(mapStackItemToSegment) };
  }
}
```
The shell checks whether the root breadcrumb item has `descriptorId === "workspace"` to decide whether to render the workspace-aware header layout (with `DesktopBreadcrumbBar` receiving a `workspace` prop) vs. a plain segment list.

### E. Workspace Root Label Patching

**`/apps/desktop/src/navigation/location-navigation.ts:856`**
```typescript
if (input.workspace && breadcrumbStack.length > 0 && breadcrumbStack[0].descriptorId === "workspace") {
  breadcrumbStack = [
    { ...breadcrumbStack[0], label: input.workspace.name ?? breadcrumbStack[0].label },
    ...breadcrumbStack.slice(1),
  ];
}
```
When building a breadcrumb stack and a workspace object is available, the root item's label is overridden with the workspace's display name if its `descriptorId` is `"workspace"`.

### F. Inferring descriptorId for Breadcrumb Navigation

**`/apps/desktop/src/components/navigation/desktop-breadcrumb-bar.tsx:30-41`**
```typescript
function inferDescriptorId(href: string, descriptorId?: ...) {
  if (descriptorId === "workspace-web") return "workspace-web";
  if (descriptorId === "workspace-page") return "workspace-page";
  if (href.startsWith("/workspace/")) return "workspace";
  return "settings";
}
```
When the user clicks a breadcrumb item to navigate, this function preserves specific `descriptorId` values (`workspace-web`, `workspace-page`) but falls back to coarser types for passing to `openPath`.

---

## 4. Complete Set of Distinct `descriptorId` Values

| `"workspace-agent"` | `createStackForLocation`, `use-desktop-routing.ts` | Individual agent detail page |

| `"virtual-folder"` | `createStackForLocation`, `location-navigation.ts`, `workspace-files.tsx`, `page-navigation-state.ts` | Non-navigable grouping node (apps root, settings parent, files folder) |
